Subject: Flight options for Pegasus onsite (arrive July 20)

Hi TravelOps / Elena,

We’re finalizing travel for the Pegasus onsite on July 20. We need three arrivals (Alex, Laura, Sean) into BOS on the morning/early afternoon of July 20. Key constraints: rehearsal at 4:00 PM at the client office (we need to be at the office by 3:00 PM latest for AV setup), and one of the execs (Sean) prefers a single checked bag. Budget: coach, but avoid >5h total travel time if possible.

Please propose two hold options (A/B) for each traveler with flight numbers, layover cities, total elapsed time, and hold codes. If there’s an option that gets us in before 2:45 PM, highlight it (Elena requested an arrival window—see below). Also include estimated ticket total and any change fees.

Seat preferences: Alex (aisle), Laura (window), Sean (bulkhead if available). If there’s a cost-effective premium economy that reduces connection risk, note that too.

Thanks — can you put proposals by EOD today? I’ll loop in Karthik for expense approval once we pick.

—
Alex Martinez
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: TravelOps <bookings@travelops.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@pegasushealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Flight options for Pegasus onsite (arrive July 20)

Hi Alex / team,

Thanks — options below (we placed short holds). Attachments: pegasus_itinerary_v2.pdf (full combined itinerary), redwood_travel_policy.pdf.

Option A (faster for Alex + Laura):
- Alex: UA 2413 / UA 678 (one stop SFO -> ORD -> BOS). Depart 06:10 SFO, arrive BOS 13:45. Total elapsed 6h35m. Hold GA9X3 (expires 07/14 17:00).
- Laura: AA 347 / AA 220 (one stop SFO -> PHL -> BOS). Depart 06:35 SFO, arrive BOS 14:10. Total 6h35m. Hold GA9X4.
- Sean: Delta DL 842 nonstop SFO -> BOS (depart 07:25, arrive 15:10). Total 5h45m. Hold GA9X5.

Option B (more reliable connections, earlier BOS arrival window):
- Alex: AZ 345 / AZ 912 (SFO -> BOS via JFK). Depart 05:55 SFO, arrive BOS 12:40 (total 5h45m). Hold HB2F7.
- Laura: AZ 349 / AZ 912 (SFO -> BOS via JFK). Depart 06:05 SFO, arrive BOS 12:40. Hold HB2F8.
- Sean: AZ 351 nonstop SFO -> BOS (depart 07:00, arrive 13:45). Hold HB2F9.

Notes: Option B gets Alex to BOS before 13:00, which gives more cushion for traffic and AV setup. Price delta between A/B is modest (~$45 per pax). If you confirm B, we’ll request seat assignments (aisle/window/bulkhead) and reissue with boarding-pass stubs.

Attachment stubs: [Attachment: pegasus_itinerary_v2.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: redwood_travel_policy.pdf (application/pdf)].

—
TravelOps (on behalf of Redwood Travel)
bookings@travelops.com

Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Flight options for Pegasus onsite (arrive July 20)

Thanks — go ahead and lock Option B for all three. A couple of follow-ups:

1) Can you swap Alex’s connection so it routes through BOS via a single shorter layover (prefer JFK connection shown is fine but if you can make the connection under 60 minutes that would be ideal). Avoid >90m layovers where possible.
2) Seat requests: Alex (aisle, window row preference 20-25 if possible), Laura (window), Sean (bulkhead or extra legroom).
3) Sean will check one bag. Please add checked baggage to his PNR.
4) Please cc Karthik once the final PNRs are issued for immediate approval on Concur.

If Elena needs us earlier than 2:45 PM, let me know and we can try to move to an earlier flight (but we prefer Option B as-is if it gets us in by ~12:40).

—
Alex
From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@pegasushealth.com>

Subject: Re: Flight options for Pegasus onsite (arrive July 20)

Alex — thanks, Option B looks good. A few logistics on our side:

- We have a shuttle scheduled from Logan that can pick up at the terminal at 13:30 or 15:15. Earlier pickup (13:30) is preferred if you can arrive by 13:00–13:15. If not, the 15:15 pickup still works but it compresses the prep time.
- Catering request: we’ll need to note two vegetarian meals during setup. I’ll send a separate catering note.
- For vendor ID badges, please have a list of full names and company titles ready at check-in.

If travelops can confirm final boarding passes and arrival times, we’ll lock the shuttle. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Elena Gomez
VP Product Operations
Pegasus Health
